subject: Conference follow-up: inference deployment discussion
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Devon Harris <devon@edgeai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Conference follow-up: inference deployment discussion

Hi Devon — great meeting you at the Inference Summit yesterday. Thanks for taking a few minutes to demo EdgeAI's sensor pipeline — I thought the low-latency requirements and the distributed edge deployment you mentioned map well to a couple of things we've been doing at Redwood.

Quick recap from my side:
- Goal: reduce tail latency for on-device inference and centralize model updates without increasing per-token cost.
- Typical approaches: Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput + Private (VPC/on-prem) for regulated deployments.

Attached is the short deck I mentioned from the conference with a couple of relevant case studies. Would love to do a 30-minute discovery to walk through your current stack (model formats, infra, traffic profiles) and identify a pragmatic rollout path. Are you available for a call next week? A few slots that work for me: Wed 4/6 10:00–11:00 PT, Thu 4/7 14:00–15:00 PT, or Fri 4/8 09:00–09:30 PT.

If those don't work, happy to send a calendar invite for any time that suits your team.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood-conference-deck.pdf (2.4MB) 
From: Devon Harris <devon@edgeai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Moore <evan@edgeai.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Conference follow-up: inference deployment discussion

Hi Marissa — thanks for the follow-up and for stopping by our booth. The deck looks useful. We are still in the early scoping phase and our procurement timeline is a little fuzzy at the moment. A couple quick asks: could you send a one-page summary focused on Dedicated vs Private options and a rough pricing band for a 3–5 GPU deployment so I can share with our CTO (cc'd)?

We're likely evaluating solutions later in Q3, but I'll share the materials internally and try to lock a short call for the week of 4/6 if possible.

Thanks,
Devon
Head of Platform | EdgeAI
devon@edgeai.com

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Conference follow-up: inference deployment discussion

Hi Devon — appreciate the quick reply. Per your ask I've attached a one-pager that highlights the Dedicated vs Private tradeoffs, expected latency profiles, and a ballpark price range for a small Dedicated pool (3–5 GPUs) including burst options and support tiers.

If it helps, I can do a 20–30 minute technical discovery with you + Evan to capture model sizes, peak qps, and any regulatory constraints (KMS/HSM, audit logs). My availability next week: Wed 4/6 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 4/7 14:00–14:30 PT.

If timelines have shifted, just let me know — happy to hold until Q3 if that's better for EdgeAI.

Best,
Marissa
